instrument: Minnesota 60-day rule for city action on development applications
summary: A city must act on a development application within 60 days, extendable by the city to 120 days; further extensions only by the applicant. Failure to act results in automatic approval. In Inver Grove Heights the 120-day deadline (July 1, 2026) shaped how and when the council could apply its moratorium to a pending data center.

source.citation: As described on the City of Inver Grove Heights proposed data center page

confidence_note: Statute not read; described by the city. Relevant anywhere a moratorium is drafted after an application is filed.
